1.1.2.title: Ensure /tmp is configured
1.1.2.description: The /tmp directory is a world-writable directory used for temporary storage by all users and some applications.
1.1.2.rationale: Making /tmp its own file system allows an administrator to set the noexec option on the mount, making /tmp useless for an attacker to install executable code.
1.1.2.remediation: Configure /tmp as separate partition or tmpfs mount

5.2.4.title: Ensure SSH root login is disabled
5.2.4.description: The PermitRootLogin parameter specifies if the root user can log in using ssh.
5.2.4.rationale: Disallowing root logins over SSH requires system admins to authenticate using their own individual account, then escalating to root via sudo or su.
